anchor.quote: An array with $D$ axes, where $D$ is the number of axes, has $D$ coordinates in each address.
Along axis $i$ an address has a coordinate $x_i$ with $0 \le x_i < t_i$, where $t_i$, the length of axis $i$, is the number of values that coordinate takes.
anchor.note: The page uses axis $i$ as a label but never says that i indexes the axes; the reader can only guess it.
